text_block_list.text:
—I stop before the front gates of the academy
and gently touch the brand-new badge pinned
to my lapel.

My heart trembles with anticipation.
...Starting today,
my days as an Umamusume Trainer
here at Tracen Academy will finally begin.

My destination has already been decided.
—It's been set in stone for a very long
time.

I run with everything I've got.
—Toward our promised meeting place.
Toward her.
And then—...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
......Hehehe.
Are you okay? Your face is completely red.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
But...
you ran all the way here in such a rush
just for me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I've been waiting for this for so long.
—"Trainer"!

Her features have matured so much since back
then. Yet that dazzling,
crystal-clear brilliance
that stirs my soul has never changed one
bit.

When I first met her—Buena Vista—
both of us were still very young.

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
—Come now,
say hello. This is <username>-kun,
who just moved in next door.
Let's make sure to be good friends, okay?
choice_data_list: Um... N-Nice to meet you, Buena-chan.
Um... N-Nice to meet you, Buena-chan.

...Big brother...? 
Um... you know what,
I'm Buu-chan. ...P-Pleased to meet you,
okay?

text_block_list.text:
...Big sister...? 
Um... you know what,
I'm Buu-chan. ...P-Pleased to meet you,
okay?

I remember.
When she timidly reached out her tiny hand
and I nervously took it in mine,
her fluffy little tail gave a soft,
gentle sway behind her back.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, uuu...gh! It hurts,
doesn't it? It must be so painful...
You've been coughing the whole time...
and your fever... uuuugh...!
choice_data_list: I'm okay, really... Don't cry, Buena.
I'm okay, really... Don't cry, Buena.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
B-But, but...! Guess what,
I've gotten so big now!
I can totally carry you on my back,
Big Brother! What do you think...!?

I can totally carry you on my back,
Big Sister! What do you think...!?

text_block_list.text:
I remember. Watching her insist so earnestly,
her rich—
perhaps overly rich—
depth of empathy and kindness warmed my
heart with fond amusement.

...I remember.
It was one day shortly after
Buena Vista had joined a club where young
Umamusume learned how to run.

text_block_list.name: Club Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Alright,
everyone! Let's get our mock race started~
Is everybody ready? On your marks... get set...
GO!!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Go! ...Hyaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... yeah, not done yet!!
Yaaaahhhhh!!

Seeing her run with all her might for the
very first time
struck my heart with such profound,
overpowering force—

...that I ended up staying awake all night,
far too excited to sleep a single wink.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Huh, you're going to a trainer academy!?
And at the URA, no less...!?

"Ever since the first time I saw you run,
all along, in my heart..."
Continuing on,
I summoned my resolve and thumped my chest
in front of her. "I want to—"
choice_data_list: I want to become your trainer someday!
I want to become your trainer someday!

text_block_list.text:
"Ever since the first time I saw you run,
all along, in my heart..."
Continuing on,
I summoned my resolve and thumped my chest
in front of her. "—"

I want to become your trainer someday!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...!! Does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...*sniff*—Jeez.
You know what a crybaby I am.
Springing that on me so suddenly...
was a little unfair, you know.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
But... thank you.
I'll do my best too.
...I swear I'll pass the Tracen Academy
entrance exam!

A childhood promise made almost entirely on
impulse.
The moment it began to shine all the brighter
was... on that day.

Buena Vista had successfully enrolled in
Tracen Academy... and as for me,
it was one autumn day when I was cramming
intensely for the Trainer Certification
Exam.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Um...
what do you think? Of that lucky charm.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I made it a lot better than the
one I gave you
for your academy entrance exams,
but... hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it! ...Oh shoot,
we'd better head to the stands soon!
We want to grab a spot with the best view
possible, right?
choice_data_list: Right. Watching live races is a pr...
Right. Watching live races is a pr...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Both of us are gonna study hard together
today!
Have you decided which Umamusume to keep an
eye on for the Japan Cup? Hey—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: For me, it has to be Special Week-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
It's Special Week! It's Special Week!!
Special Week takes the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The other Umamusume give desperate chase,
but here comes Special Week!!
Number 13, Special Week,
crossing the line in first—GOAL!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Japan's Supreme Commander, Special Week!!
Defeating even the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
winner,
she claims a magnificent!
A magnificent victory in the Japan Cup!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Amazing... amazing, amazing, amazing!!
What a run, what an impact,
what a roar from the crowd... what a—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...! —Yeah.
Yeah, it really is...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: What a truly magnificent view...!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Someday, without a doubt,
we will too—!

"Someday,
we'll definitely make it to a breathtaking
view like this."

And just like that,
our childhood promise transformed into an
irreplaceable dream for both of us.
choice_data_list: (And now, we've made it this far.)
(And now, we've made it this far.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Well then, once again...
...May I hear your answer?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...—
